physics-killer-05.goal: Analyze the principles of Object Speed and Kinematics and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-05.material: Object wey get mass $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ dey move for $+x$ direction with $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Force for $+x$ direction dey act on dis object, and di size of di force increase steadily from $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0$ during time $40\,\mathrm{N}$, e constant at $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$ during $40\,\mathrm{N}$, and e decrease steadily from $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ to $40\,\mathrm{N}$ during $0$. Which one correctly match, in order, di size of di impulse wey di object receive during di $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ wey dis force dey act, and di speed of di object just after di force disappear? (No other force dey.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.prompt: Object wey get mass $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ dey move for $+x$ direction with $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Force for $+x$ direction dey act on dis object, and di size of di force increase steadily from $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0$ during time $40\,\mathrm{N}$, e constant at $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$ during $40\,\mathrm{N}$, and e decrease steadily from $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ to $40\,\mathrm{N}$ during $0$. Which one correctly match, in order, di size of di impulse wey di object receive during di $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ wey dis force dey act, and di speed of di object just after di force disappear? (No other force dey.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.explain: Area: first triangle $\frac12\cdot0.1\cdot40=2$, rectangle $0.2\cdot40=8$, last triangle $2$, so $I=12\,\mathrm{N\cdot s}$. From $I=m(v-v_0)$ to $12=2(v-4)\Rightarrow v=10\,\mathrm{m/s}$. If you treat di whole thing as rectangle $40\cdot0.4=16$ na wrong answer ②, if you skip di triangle parts and use $8$ na wrong answer ③, and if you no divide $I$ by di mass and use $4+12=16$ na wrong answer ④.
